heroSubtitle: Building Innovative and Efficient Software Solutions
frontendP1Desc: An internal knowledge base platform (wiki) built with a robust Node.js/Express backend, a PostgreSQL database, and a reactive frontend. The project aims to centralize information and procedures, featuring user authentication, article creation/editing, and an efficient search system.
frontendP2Desc: A web application for managing and tracking support tickets, built with a modern frontend stack.
backendP1Desc: A fast and versatile PID controller library written in C++, optimized for performance in embedded systems.
backendP2Desc: Configuration for a CUPS print server running on a Raspberry Pi, enabling network printing capabilities.
aboutP1: Hello! I'm Guilherme Gonzaga, a passionate software developer from Brazil with a strong focus on backend systems and a love for elegant, efficient code. I enjoy tackling complex problems and building robust applications.
aboutP2: My experience includes working with languages like C++ and Python, and I am proficient in developing for embedded systems and server-side applications. I'm always eager to learn new technologies and contribute to challenging projects.
